You take their shaking hands and pour life into them, holding their gaze until the battlefield comes back into focus.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One willing creature within 3 squares, including self.
Duration
Healing and reductions are immediate; spent actions are not restored.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand; no item granted.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Pay 7 HP before rolling, bypassing all resistance and leaving yourself above 0. Requires a free hand. Apply Life resistance to the healing, minimum 1 while HP is missing, capped by missing HP.

Weak
Restore 8 HP and reduce temporary Dazed by 1.
Standard
Restore 16 HP and reduce temporary Dazed by 1.
Strong
Restore 24 HP, reduce temporary Dazed by 2 and temporary Blinded by 1.

Remove no starred conditions or scars. No Grit restoration or reversal of Last Words. This is a complete spell; no earlier healing card is required.

A willing creature explicitly harmed by healing instead takes the listed HP amount as Life damage, with normal resistance and minimum damage; apply no beneficial recovery riders. An unwilling creature harmed by healing can be targeted as described below.

Additional rulings

Tags: Magic / Recovery

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
